name: Submit a Signing Request
description: Submits signing request to SignPath and downloads the signed artifact

api-token.description: SignPath REST API access token. Read more in the SignPath documentation: https://about.signpath.io/redirects/connectors/api-token

github-artifact-id.description: Id of the Github Actions artifact. Use `steps.<step-id>.outputs.artifact-id` from the preceding actions/upload-artifact action step.

github-token.description: GitHub access token used to read job details and download the artifact. Defaults to the [`secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN`](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-gui

parameters.description: Multiline-string of values that map to user-defined parameters in the Artifact Configuration. Use one line per parameter with the format <name>: "<value>" where

wait-for-completion-timeout-in-seconds.description: Maximum time in seconds that the action will wait for the signing request to complete

service-unavailable-timeout-in-seconds.description: Total time in seconds that the action will wait for a single service call to succeed (across several retries)

download-signed-artifact-timeout-in-seco.description: HTTP timeout when downloading the signed artifact.

wait-for-completion.description: If true, the action will wait for the signing request to complete

output-artifact-directory.description: Path where the signed artifact will be saved. If not specified, the task will not download the signed artifact from SignPath
